adapted_entries.reason: Skills/Todo/ctxpp/CUDA root discovery uses explicit configured domain roots and LCW_*_CLI overrides.
Child supervisor launch passes through Project Control's manifest-backed bootstrap before imports.
Todo/ctxpp root discovery uses explicit configured domain roots and imports the receiver-owned local_worker package.

receiver_only_files.reason: Makes the verified local_worker.* receiver package explicit; supplier used a namespace package.

source_parity.qualification_limit: Hash and layout parity plus one deterministic policy fixture do not establish full runtime or hardware parity.

checks: A valid source manifest is inspected without importing local_worker.
The source binding exposes only the verified receiver root and leaves local_worker unimported.
Source-mode fixtures mirror src/project_control; non-checkout installed fixtures require a schema-v2 digest-pinned release manifest.

A deliberately inherited schema-v2 old-release pin without local_runtime_binding is rejected as runtime_release_binding_missing; each source-mode test removes inherited release pins and restores them after the case.
Caller-selected roots, changed manifest-covered files, stale installed release roots, and foreign already-loaded local_worker modules fail closed before binding/import.

A real local_worker.supervisor module executing VERSION='old' remains old after its source and manifest change to VERSION='new'; rebinding returns runtime_fingerprint_changed_restart_required, including after clearing the module cache.
A same-root local_worker module preloaded before any verified bind is rejected.
A valid schema-v2 installed release manifest accepts only its exact receiver manifest hash and fingerprint.
Importing the real receiver supervisor does not call subprocess.Popen.
Supplier and receiver local_worker.policy imports produce identical output for the same host-evidence fixture.
Receiver controller domain-tool paths use explicit configured Skills roots or LCW_*_CLI overrides and fail closed when no trusted paths are configured.

A malicious project_control package under the untrusted workspace cannot shadow the supervisor bootstrap when the child runs from the trusted package parent; forwarded invalid arguments reach the supervisor parser without starting a process.

SupervisorClient.ensure_running is exercised with subprocess.Popen mocked; its argv, exact package-parent cwd, controlled PYTHONPATH ordering, and environment passthrough are asserted without starting a child.
The current public MCP profile record contains observer 11, codex 12, and mutator 16 tool schemas.

A stale timestamp pyc with identical file size and integer nanosecond mtime would ordinarily load version A; the verified canonical loader executes version B from manifest-hashed raw source and leaves that pyc unchanged.
The `python -m project_control.runtime_binding local_worker.supervisor` child bootstrap forwards an invalid argument to the actual supervisor parser and exits before a subprocess/model server starts.

assertions: A candidate has no project_control_observer_analysis.pth file.
The release pins project_control/local_runtime by receiver manifest SHA-256 and file fingerprint.
The trusted observer factory pins the receiver observer source digest and runtime identity.
A stale supplier digest and a foreign runtime root are rejected.
The analysis cache identity is bound to the receiver digest and qualification state.

public_mcp_schema_reference.schema_identity: SHA-256 of compact sorted-key JSON schema bytes, UTF-8 with ensure_ascii=False

scope_and_limits: The parity test compares a deterministic policy object and decisions using the supplier and receiver imports; it does not run the complete supplier test suite against both roots.
Supervisor launch coverage captures the production subprocess.Popen call without starting a child; it does not qualify service startup, model execution, GPU scheduling, or device behavior.
The installed binding success case uses a source-shaped fixture and the installer suite emulates wheel contents; no full release wheel was built or promoted.
This record does not establish Skills retirement, installed release activation, or production binding promotion.
